name: Strawberry Shrimp Arugula Salad with Feta, Almonds & Herb Vinaigrette

instructions.primary_message: Drain shrimp in a colander and rinse under cold water until there are no more ice chunks. Spread out on a clean towel and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ⅛ kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce (skip the arugula if it came pre-washed).
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (142 g) pkg baby arugula
3 (454 g) pkgs strawberries
1 ½ small bunches green onions (scallions)
3 lemons

instructions.primary_message: Trim off the stem ends and slice the strawberries; add to a medium salad bowl along with the arugula.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle; add to the bowl with the strawberries and toss to combine.
Juice lemon into a small bowl; add oil, Dijon, vinegar, maple syrup, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
2 tbsp pure maple syrup
¾ tsp dill
¾ tsp basil
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the shrimp and garlic to the skillet; cook until shrimp are opaque, 1-2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate. Cook in batches if necessary.
To serve, divide the salad between the plates, top with feta, sliced almonds, and shrimp. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese
¾ cup almonds, sliced

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
